programme.title: 200 Pounds Beauty [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Han-na is a large girl with a warm heart, who also has an unbelievable voice. She wants to become a pop-singer, but because she is unattractive, she’s only given opportunities to ghost-sing for a popular singer named Amy. Han-na is also in love with Amy’s producer, Sang-joon, but Sang-joon doesn’t notice her. One day, Han-Na is invited to Sang-Joon’s birthday party and receives a red dress from him to wear to his party. But at the party when she runs into Amy in the same red dress, Han-na is embarrassed with herself and disappears. 1 year later, Han-na returns as the beautiful Jenny.

programme.title: IP MAN 3 [English Dub]
programme.desc: When a band of brutal gangsters led by a crooked property developer make a play to take over the city, Master Ip is forced to take a stand.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time in Shanghai [English Dub]
programme.desc: A laborer moves to Shanghai in the hope of becoming rich. But ends up using his kung fu skills to survive. Remake of The Boxer From Shantung.

programme.title: The Unrighteous [English Sub]
programme.desc: A realistic horror film about a young man trying to protect his family from his neighbors after illegal flyers are distributed in an old villa in the suburbs, leading to a sense of unease.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A man has an obsession that, if he is to die, it would be by being killed by a high school girl. With his strange obsession in mind, he decides to become a teacher.

programme.title: Airpocalypse [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ma Le, a psychologist who calls himself a "suicide intervention master," makes money off the misfortunes of others. One day, a "birthday star" falls from the sky and hits Ma Le. Having accidentally inhaled divine energy, Ma Le is told that the world is on the verge of collapse and that only by gathering the four gods of wind, rain, thunder, and lightning, who have been banished to the mortal realm, can everything be changed. Thus, the gods and mortals embark on a hilarious, fantastical, and thrilling journey...

programme.title: Ghost Blows The Lamp of the Longling Temple [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Shirley Yang returns to China in search of professor Sun to rid herself of her erythema, only to find him trapped in the mysterious Long Ling cave.

programme.title: The Night Owl [English Dub]
programme.desc: A period drama film, depicting Joseon Dynasty in Korea. Kyoung-su is a skilled acupuncturist but a blind who can only see a little at dark. Right after Kyoung-su joins King Injo’s medical team, the prince comes back after 7 years of living in Chung dynasty. Due to a long journey coming back, the prince becomes ill, and the king’s doctor brings Kyoung-su to heal him. But while Kyoung-su is doing his work, he finds out the king’s hidden secret which might change everything that the king owns. Could Kyoung-su be able to save everyone and himself?

programme.title: Mad Cats [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: On a quest to find his missing brother, Taka teams up with a quirky new friend and an edgy, mysterious girl to take on a pack of vicious assassins with 9 lives!

programme.title: The Big Call [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ding Xiao Tian is a young policeman whose sole goal is to catch Lin A Hai, the leader of a ring that deals in phone scams, and have caused his high-school teacher to commit suicide after being bankrupted by them. Eventually, Ding finds himself a temporary member of the Anti-Telecommunication Fraud Centre in Donghai city, under the leadership of Tan Si Rong, who explains to him the actual size of Lin A Hai and his girlfriend’s, Liu Li Fang’s ring, which has spread to Hong Kong and Thailand, “succeeding” in hundreds of frauds, even including millionaires. At the same time, Ding Xiao Tian learns that an ex-classmate of his from the police academy, Xu Xiao Tu, has infiltrated the Thai headquarters of the ring, run by Liu Li Fang. The story then unfolds into three axes, one focused on the two police officers, the other on Xu Xiaotu and Liu Li Fang, and the last on Lin A Hai, who also experiences some struggles.

programme.title: The Witch: Subversion [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Ja-yoon enters a TV contest to help her family, but mysterious figures disrupt her life, revealing secrets from her forgotten past.

programme.title: Confession [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Min-ho's adulterous lover Se-hee is murdered in a hotel where only the two of them were present, and Min-ho is immediately singles out as the prime suspect. Insisting on his innocence, Min-ho hires the talented lawyer Shin-ae to defend him, and confesses to her that a car accident on the day before may be connected to Se-hee's murder...

programme.title: Yesterday Once More [English Subtitle]

After experiencing the happiness and sweetness of love, they had to face the test of fate together. Can the miracle of love keep them together?

programme.title: The Great Battle [English Dub]
programme.desc: Witness the epic Siege of Ansi, where Goguryeo warriors defend against 500,000 Tang soldiers in THE GREAT BATTLE.

programme.title: THE PRIESTS [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A priest and a skeptical young deacon try to save a girl who falls into a mysterious coma after a hit-and-run. Suspecting demonic possession, they perform an exorcism, but as they uncover the entity’s dark origins, they face a terrifying battle of faith and survival.

programme.title: The Getaway [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Three girls are abducted and taken to a remote island. They're held captive by three brothers raised in isolation by their grandmother. The girls are forced to become the brothers' mates and desperately attempt to escape their captors.

programme.title: HELTER SKELTER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Top star Lilico undergoes multiple cosmetic surgeries to her entire body. As her surgeries show side effect.

programme.title: Tazza: The Hidden Card [English Dub]
programme.desc: Dae-gil, a young man with natural born talents in gambling, makes a dazzling debut as a gambler and gets reunited with his first love, Mi-na. However, Dae-gil soon becomes the scapegoat of betrayal and conspiracy and is forced to be on the run. Dae-gil plans to get revenge and prepares for one big, fated game for Mi-na who has been helping him every step of the way.

programme.title: Escape from the 21st Century [English Dub]

programme.title: The Goblin [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Doo-hyeon, who goes by the name the ''Goblin'', goes to prison for taking the fall for Yeong-min who killed their boss. Released after 10 years, Doo-hyeon had been living a normal life, until he found out Yeong-min had been taking advantage of his name. Yeong-min goes so far as to kidnap Doo-hyeon's daughter to keep his mouth shut. Enraged, Doo-hyeon seeks revenge and announces the return of the real ''Goblin''.

programme.title: Upstream [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Gao Zhilei's impulsive decision to become a stay-at-home husband leads to unforeseen challenges. As life takes a reverse turn, he's forced to face responsibilities as the family's breadwinner, ultimately finding himself and starting anew.

programme.title: High Forces [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: Distanced from his family after a car accident takes the sight of his daughter, a father must use his professional bodyguard training when a flight they're on is overtaken by armed hijackers. A taut puzzle of deception unravels when the hijackers' motivations are revealed and the father must rescue not only his daughter and wife, but all those aboard.

programme.title: Ditto [English Dub]
programme.desc: A story about the love and friendship that takes place in an era where a man and a woman communicate through radio by chance.

programme.title: Hansan: Rising Dragon [English Dub]
programme.desc: In 1592, Admiral Yi Sun-sin uses the Turtle Ship to battle Japanese forces off Hansan Island. Epic naval clash ensues
